reason: A web access-control utility for DeepSeek Harness that exposes the service on LAN interfaces while gating UI and API access with a password, CIDR allowlist, and forwarding-header policy.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供局域网访问控制，通过密码、CIDR 白名单和转发请求头策略限制 UI 与 API 的访问。
summaries.en: Provides LAN access control for DeepSeek Harness Web using password authentication, CIDR allowlisting, and forwarding-header policies for the UI and API.

capabilities: Changes the web server binding to listen on all interfaces
Enforces password authentication for the web UI and API
Restricts inbound IPv4 clients using configurable CIDR allowlists
Rejects requests containing selected forwarding headers
Stores access policy and session verification data locally
